title: hl2270dw-ipp-bridge
description: Configuration for the Brother HL-2270DW CUPS IPP-Everywhere bridge chart. In addition to the keys defined here, all values of the TrueCharts 'common' chart (service, workload, podOptions, persistence, ...) are accepted - see https://truecharts.org/common/

printer.description: Physical printer and CUPS queue settings.

name.description: CUPS queue name, also the IPP resource path (ipp://<svc>:631/printers/<name>).

ppd.description: PPD override, e.g. drv:///brlaser.drv/brl2370d.ppd. Empty means auto-pick the certified family (2370dn > 2270dw > brlaser > generpcl).

uuid.description: IPP Everywhere UUID advertised by the queue (exposed as PRINTER_UUID). Windows caches this per printer, so keep it stable across redeploys. Must match the UUID in the Avahi _ipps TXT record used for discovery. Set per deployment; the committed value is only an example placeholder.
